projectSummary: A concrete mechanism for why bench press EMG amplitude comparisons in this literature disagree with each other. Carried into the contradiction map and used to qualify every tier-4 statement.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

study.intervention: Single-differential surface EMG mapping of innervation zone position during the bench press.
study.population: Single-differential surface EMGs were collected from 15 regions along the cranial, centro-cranial, centro-caudal and caudal fibres of the pectoralis major while 11 healthy participants contracted isometrically, and innervation zones were identified visually.

title: Innervation zone locations distribute medially within the pectoralis major muscle during bench press exercise.
